text:
AutoPagerBot: PAGER P1 - billing.metering.token_drift in eu-west-1 > alert_threshold. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/billing-token-drift :rotating_light:

jess: taking oncall. pinging eng-sre and billing.

omar: oncall here. any customer-facing impact yet?

liam: seeing elevated token deltas in the recent 15m window. quick snapshot:
```
metric: token_emit_rate
baseline: 3k/min
now: 15k/min
delta: +12k/min (eu-west-1 emitter group)
```

krista: support getting a couple of overage emails from 3 paying customers, escalated to me. IDs: o-17, o-42, o-88. They're asking why billing jumped.

ojmar: (typo) oops meant omar: starting emitter health checks and kafka offsets.

omar: kafka consumer lag looks fine, but emitter commit_offsets jumped between 1784242000-1784242400. sample log:
```
WARN metering/emitter - commit delta: 12489 - 12345 = 144 (unexpected spikes)
INFO metering/publish - batch_tokens=4800, retries=0
```

liam: running quick reconcile against archived ledger to compare counted vs emitted. kicking off recon script: `scripts/recon_tokens.py --start 1784242000 --end 1784242400 --region eu-west-1`

recon-bot: recon job queued (id: recon-1784242). ETA ~6m. posting partial diffs to this thread when ready.

jess: good. omar — if emitter is double-emitting on retry path, prepare a hotfix toggle to disable emitter-burst path. Runbook step 3.

omar: noted. creating hotpatch branch and will deploy a rollback of emitter-backoff handler to canary. `/deploy canary metering-emitter rollback-hotpatch`

liam: recon partial: counts_emitted - counts_billed = +10340 tokens across three orgs (o-17:o-42:o-88 => 4200:3400:2740). Looks like emission was batched unusually.

krista: raising customer comms draft: "We're investigating an unusual billing spike in eu-west-1; will follow up within 2 hours with correction or credit." Want to wait for recon final before sending?

jess: yes wait for final. prioritize mitigation + short-term credit plan if numbers hold. Omar, proceed with canary rollback and flag me.

omar: canary started. will monitor latency and error rates. `/status canary` -> healthy so far.

recon-bot: recon complete (recon-1784242). final diff attached: `+10340 tokens` attrib to emitter-batch-split bug in v2.3.1. Suggest auto-credit for affected orgs and a rate-limited re-emit correction disabled.

liam: creating billing adjustment ticket: BLG-5123 with reconciliation CSV. link: https://redwood.internal/ops/billing/BLG-5123

krista: I'll draft customer notices and coordinate credits. tagging finance for approvals. @finance Please review BLG-5123.

jess: nice. post-mortem: include timeline, root cause (batch-split emitter regression v2.3.1), detection (monitoring heuristics to catch >5x baseline), and actions (auto-credit, hotpatch rollback, regression test added). I'll create the incident epic after stabilization.

omar: hotpatch canary rolled back to v2.3.0 at 1784242700, metrics trending back to baseline. closing P1 pager if no further spike in 15m.

krista: customers informed with provisional credit plan.

jess: closing notes: keep this thread pinned to the incident epic. great coordination. :thumbsup:
